phase_name: Resolve the two dead EXTENSION.md files

objectives.description: Make check-extension-docs.sh manifest-authoritative on merge_targets.claudemd.source (required-file gate, Rule U gate, accidental-omission advisory, rationale comment) and repoint the 3 stale doc cross-references plus the extension-slim-standard.md note
Delete core/EXTENSION.md and slidev/EXTENSION.md; confirm manifests do not declare EXTENSION.md in provides; re-run checker to confirm clean for core/slidev

deviations.description: Run REPO_ROOT=$(pwd) bash check-extension-docs.sh and confirm it still passes with both dead files still present
deviations.reason: At the moment of the sub-step commit, editing check-extension-docs.sh in the source store appeared to desync it from the already-deployed .claude/scripts/check-extension-docs.sh copy (Rule F script-drift check), producing a transient FAIL for 'core' orthogonal to Rule U / the required-file gate this phase targets. Verified via git-stash A/B test that core passed cleanly before the edit. A PostToolUse hook evidently auto-syncs the deployed copy shortly after an Edit/Write to the extension source (confirmed by re-diffing .claude/scripts/check-extension-docs.sh against the source moments later -- byte-identical, no manual sync performed), so by the time both dead files were deleted and the checker was re-run, core and slidev both showed full PASS with zero Rule U lines and zero missing-file failures. A synthetic test (temporarily removing python/EXTENSION.md, which IS its claudemd source) confirmed the gate still hard-fails correctly, proving the gate was narrowed rather than disabled.
deviations.annotation: *(deviation: altered -- transient drift self-resolved via an apparent auto-sync hook; final state is a full clean PASS, not merely the narrower criteria first verified)*
